img.start-page: The Get started page shown while nothing is open: three steps, and a card each for the live camera, a picture and a video. The settings are on the right
img.setup-guide: The first page of the setup guide, with the language list, the System, Dark and Light theme buttons, and Skip, Back and Next
img.picture-dlss5: A VRChat photo open in the window. A white line with a round handle splits it: the original on the left, the DLSS 5 output on the right. The library is below the picture, the settings on the right, and Process & save PNG at the top right
img.picture-output: The same photo with Compare set to the output only: the whole picture is the DLSS 5 result
img.picture-depth-view: The same photo in the depth view: near parts are bright, far parts are dark
img.light-theme: The same window in the light theme
img.video: A video open in the window with the comparison line. Under the picture are the timeline, the play and step buttons, the time, and Start here, End here and Whole video
img.library: The library under the picture with five files, each with its size; the buttons Add files, Add folder, Process selected, Process all and Delete are on the right
img.sidebar-source: The Source section in picture mode: Open image, the open file with its size, and Custom output resolution
img.sidebar-dlss5: The DLSS 5 Neural Rendering section with Advanced on: Enable DLSS 5 (DLSSNR) with the Active badge, Runtime path, Preset, Style, the four strength sliders, Output blend and the readouts
img.sidebar-output: The Capture section: the Process & save PNG button, Folder, Output file name, Also save the original frame and Keep transparency (alpha)
img.sidebar-depth-motion: The Frame guidance (motion & depth) section: Motion vectors, Flow grid, Flow quality, Depth, Depth network resolution and Depth model
img.sidebar-display: The Display section: Theme, Compare, Zoom, Checkerboard behind transparency, Show the library, Show overlay info, Show log, Reopen the last file at start, V-Sync and Processing rate cap
img.sidebar-mcp: The MCP section: Run the MCP server, Reach, Port, Read only, Copy client configuration, the keys and the job queue
img.sidebar-about: The About section: the version, driver checks, Update channel, GitHub access, and the buttons Check for updates, Open log file, Open settings folder, Report a problem, Documentation and Setup guide
img.driver-notice: The notice A newer graphics driver is needed: the installed driver 536.99 on the left of a bar, the required 616.56 on the right, and the buttons Close and Download driver
img.update-window: The Update available window: the version, the release notes in a scrolling box, and the buttons Update now, Release page and Later
img.radeon-sidebar: The DLSS 5 section of the Radeon edition: Install DLSS-NR-on-AMD, Licence, Release page and Reload, with the requirements under them
